selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main point of the First Truth in this passage?
questions.answer: It teaches that only Allah truly deserves worship.

questions.question: What are some things in the universe that lead people to worship and thank Allah?
questions.answer: The many blessings and gifts people receive lead them to praise, thank, and worship Allah.

questions.question: How do animals and even nonliving things show a kind of worship in the passage?
questions.answer: They do it by carrying out the jobs and purposes given to them.

questions.question: What do revelation, inspiration, and unseen spiritual signs all agree on?
questions.answer: They all point to Allah alone as the One worthy of worship.

questions.question: Why does the passage say absolute Divinity cannot have any partner?
questions.answer: Because if others shared in worship, it would go against the very meaning and purpose of true Divinity.

questions.question: Who are described as the aware and living fruits at the top of creation?
questions.answer: Human beings who worship and give thanks.

questions.question: Why might people wrongly turn away from their real object of worship?
questions.answer: Because Allah is unseen, so some people may forget Him quickly and become attached to other things.

questions.question: What would be wrong if something else made people feel deeply thankful in a way that pulled them away from Allah?
questions.answer: It would wrongly take worship away from the One who truly deserves it.

questions.question: Why does the Qur’an strongly reject shirk in this passage?
questions.answer: Because giving worship to others besides Allah opposes the truth of Allah’s sole right to be worshipped.

questions.question: What warning does the passage say the Qur’an gives to people who commit shirk?
questions.answer: It warns them of Hellfire.

questions.question: In the passage, what does “absolute Divinity” mean in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means Allah alone has the full right to be worshipped.

questions.question: How do different groups of people show this truth according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are naturally drawn to different forms of worship based on how they were created.

questions.question: Besides people, what other parts of creation are mentioned as showing worship?
questions.answer: Animals and even nonliving things are mentioned.

questions.question: How do the gifts in the universe affect people’s hearts?
questions.answer: They push people to be thankful, grateful, and full of praise.

questions.question: What kinds of signs from beyond the seen world are mentioned?
questions.answer: Spiritual experiences, revelation, and inspiration are mentioned.

questions.question: What do all these signs together prove?
questions.answer: They prove that one single Divinity rules and deserves worship.

questions.question: Why is sharing worship with others called impossible in this passage?
questions.answer: Because true Divinity does not allow anyone else to share that place.

questions.question: What special place do worshipping people have in the universe, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are presented as the highest, aware result of creation.

questions.question: What bad result would happen if people were made to forget Allah and turn to others?
questions.answer: The purpose of worship would be spoiled and directed the wrong way.

questions.question: Based on the passage, what is one reason the Qur’an speaks so firmly against polytheism?
questions.answer: Because polytheism steals worship away from Allah alone.

questions.question: What truth is being explained in the marked passage?
questions.answer: The truth of Allah’s sole Divinity.

questions.question: What human response is connected to blessings in the universe?
questions.answer: People are moved to thank, praise, and worship.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the actions of living creatures and nonliving things?
questions.answer: Their actions and duties show a kind of worship through obedience to their created roles.

questions.question: What do all the spiritual signs mentioned in the passage point toward?
questions.answer: They point toward Allah alone.
